body.text:
listen: 0.0.0.0:8080
pools:
  haiku:
    members:
    - model: claude-haiku
  fast:
    members:
    - model: claude-haiku
    - model: gpt-4o-mini
  balanced:
    members:
    - model: claude-sonnet
      weight: 8
    - model: gpt-4o
      weight: 2
  long-context:
    members:
    - model: claude-sonnet
      context_max: 200000
    - model: gemini-1.5-pro
      context_max: 2000000
  resilient:
    members:
    - model: claude-sonnet
      weight: 3
    - model: gpt-4o
      weight: 2
    - model: glm-4.6
      weight: 1
    failover:
      timeout_secs: 30
      max_hops: 3
      exclusions:
      - glm-4.6
  realtime:
    members:
    - model: gemini-1.5-pro
      attempt_timeout_ms: 250
    - model: claude-haiku
  primary:
    members:
    - model: claude-sonnet
    - model: gpt-4o
    on_exhausted:
      fallback_pool: overflow
  overflow:
    members:
    - model: claude-haiku
    - model: gpt-4o-mini
    - model: glm-4.6
    on_exhausted: least_bad
  smart:
    members:
    - model: claude-sonnet
      weight: 2
    - model: gpt-4o
      weight: 2
    - model: gemini-1.5-pro
      weight: 1
    affinity:
      mode: session
      header_name: x-session-id
  sensitive:
    members:
    - model: claude-sonnet
    - model: gpt-4o
    breaker:
      trip:
        mode: consecutive
        consecutive_n: 2
      base_cooldown_secs: 5
      max_cooldown_secs: 60
  upstream_credentials: own
providers:
  anthropic:
    api_key:
      env: ANTHROPIC_KEY
  openai:
    api_key:
      env: OPENAI_KEY
  gemini:
    api_key:
      env: GEMINI_KEY
  z.ai:
    api_key:
      env: ZAI_KEY
  bedrock:
    api_key:
      env: AWS_BEDROCK_CREDS
models:
  claude-sonnet:
    provider: anthropic
    max_concurrent: 20
    max_requests: -1
  claude-haiku:
    provider: anthropic
    max_concurrent: 40
    max_requests: -1
  gpt-4o:
    provider: openai
    max_concurrent: 20
    max_requests: -1
  gpt-4o-mini:
    provider: openai
    max_concurrent: 50
    max_requests: -1
  gemini-1.5-pro:
    provider: gemini
    max_concurrent: 15
    max_requests: -1
  glm-4.6:
    provider: z.ai
    max_concurrent: 10
    max_requests: -1
  claude-sonnet-bedrock:
    provider: bedrock
    max_concurrent: 20
    max_requests: -1
auth:
  chain:
  - keys
  signing_key:
    file: /var/lib/busbar/signing.key
  admin_auth:
  - admin-tokens
identity-providers:
  admin-tokens:
    module: admin-tokens
    token:
      env: BUSBAR_ADMIN_TOKEN

effects.stderr:
migrated 'tests/migration-corpus/from-tags/v1.5.2_config.yaml' to the 1.5.0 config shape. CHANGES (2): - auth chain entry `admin-tokens: { … }` -> identity-providers.admin-tokens + a bare-name reference (1.5.3: define once, reference by name) - auth.upstream_credentials -> pools.upstream_credentials (the all-pools SCALAR default; override it per pool with `pools.

.upstream_credentials`) Review the output, then run `busbar --validate` on it before deploying. NOTE: 1.x virtual keys do not carry over - mint fresh signed keys (the 1.5.0 security headline: keys now expire).
